thread:
Will (Design): quick sync — on‑prem setup wizard: i'm exploring splitting the current 'Network checks' step into two panels: 'Live connectivity tests' (attempts to reach customer endpoints from infra) and 'Static prerequisites' (CIDR, DNS, hostnames, certs). Sketch: https://img.redwood.ai/ux/sketch1.png
Anika (Eng): splitting is fine backend-wise, but we need to be explicit about eventual order. Live tests are async and flaky — shouldn't block final submit. propose: run live tests in background, show best-effort results, and require only static checklist for gating.
Maria (Product): agree. copy: header should be "Network prerequisites" not "Network checks". short blurb: "Confirm network settings your infra team manages. Live tests help debug but aren't required for setup." Add link to KB: https://kb.redwood.ai/onprem/network-prereqs
Lee (DevEx): UX suggestion: collapse "Advanced network settings" by default (mtu, proxy, custom routes). show a single CTA: `Run quick connectivity test` which shows terminal-friendly output. For advanced users, provide a `Download preflight script` button.
Sam (Accessibility): +1 to collapse. also: when live tests update, use `aria-live="polite"` and announce pass/fail to screen readers. color alone can't indicate fail/passing — include icons and text. keyboard focus order must skip hidden advanced section.
Anika (Eng): flag: live tests call out to customer endpoints — we need explicit consent / opt-in toggle. add a checkbox: "Allow Redwood to run live connectivity tests from hosted infra" with a short explainer.
Will (Design): copy option: checkbox label `Allow Redwood to run live connectivity tests (recommended)` and help tooltip: `We only test outbound connectivity to your allowed hosts to help debug connectivity problems.`
Maria (Product): also we should capture minimal telemetry: test durations, DNS resolution errors, http vs tls handshake error codes. store under customer org only with opt-in.
Anika (Eng): sample CLI for local preflight that we can offer as alt flow:
`````
# quick tcp check
nc -zv 10.0.0.5 443 || echo "port closed"
# http health
curl -sS -I https://10.0.0.5/health || echo "unreachable"
`````
Lee (DevEx): can we add small inline explanations for error lines like "tls handshake" and quick remediation links? keeps support burden lower.
Will (Design): propose compact layout: left column static checklist, right column live test box with streaming log and `Run tests` CTA. mobile: stack them.
Sam (Accessibility): ensure streaming logs have `role="log"` and each new line is readable. when failing, focus should move to the first failing checklist item so keyboard users can act quickly.
infra-bot: preflight-runner: flagging flaky host validation: some hosts respond only to SNI — record that edge-case for backend.
Anika (Eng): noted. will add a fallback that tries connecting with SNI set and without.
Maria (Product): outstanding action items: 1) design mockups for split layout (will) 2) copy updates and KB draft (maria) 3) opt-in checkbox + consent copy (anika) 4) accessibility pattern doc (sam) 5) add download preflight script (lee)
Will (Design): i'll post Figma frames by EOD tomorrow. ping me for quick reviews :pray:
Lee (DevEx): i'll prototype the script and sample terminal output.
Sam (Accessibility): i'll sketch ARIA annotations and keyboard flow tonight.
Anika (Eng): i'll wire up backend toggles and async live-run behavior, ETA 1 week.
Maria (Product): thanks all — filing a JIRA with these tasks. :thumbsup:
Will (Design): :thumbsup:
